newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Golf-Australian sporting heroes unite in praise of Woods.
newsitem.headline: Golf-Australian sporting heroes unite in praise of Woods.

text.p: Australian sporting heroes have united in their praise of American golfing sensation Tiger Woods, the youngest and most decisive champion in U.S. Masters history.
Woods, 21, won the first major of the season by a massive 12 strokes, devouring the Augusta layout in the process to finish a record 18-under par.
Former world champion boxer Jeff Fenech said: "I can see him dominating for a long time as long as he keeps his head screwed on the right way."

"He's an absolute freak. To be so young and so good is unbelievable. Heaven knows what the future holds for him. He can only get better as he gains more experience," Sydney Swans full forward Tony Lockett said.

Former rugby league coach Jack Gibson said: "When Muhammad Ali was coming good, they compared him with the former greats like Sonny Liston and Joe Louis. This bloke isn't being compared to anyone. That's how good he is."

Former Australia cricket captain Greg Chappell also gave his opinion to Sydney's Daily Telegraph newspaper, saying: "I think he will take the game to a new level. It was one of the most phenomenal things I have seen."
